olivia: Hey team — SambaNova asked to join our HW onramp. They want a marketplace listing + a quick NDA + a benchmark run. Call scheduled Thu. Who can own NDA redlines and the bench plan? :wave:

raj: I can own NDA redlines. Is legal ok with our accelerated EAP terms? I'll ping legal now.

maria: I'll draft the benchmark plan — propose: microbench (throughput/latency), 99p latency, memory footprint, and 2 end-to-end flows (news summarization + embeddings). Keep it lightweight so partner can run quickly.

tom: For infra, we'll need a test bucket + sample configs. Suggest reusing the amp bench runner but add a SambaNova profile. Need kernel flags and quant settings from their eng.

raj: Legal flagged export controls + AUP checks — SambaNova seemed fine in the quick scan but we need the export checklist filled. olivia, can you drop partner contact + the NDA thread here?

olivia: Pasted partner intro below. contact: jane@sambanova.ai, eng lead: @samba_jane (partner). They asked if we can get a marketplace listing by EOW if bench looks good.

maria: For benchmark shards: 1) LM throughput (tokens/s), 2) 4k-seq p95/p99 latency, 3) batch-scaling cost curve (tokens/$), 4) perf with KV-cache warm. Will add pass/fail thresholds and dashboard panels.

tom: Ops runbook (draft):
```
- Provision NVMe-backed instance
- Pull model tarball from S3: s3://redwood-eap/sambanova/model-v1
- Start bench runner: ./bench --profile sambanova --seq 4096 --batch 8
- Collect traces to /tmp/bench-traces
- Upload results to bench-results/redwood/sambanova/
```
Will attach the runbook to the PR.

olivia: Also need a comms plan — marketing wants a joint announcement template but we'll only move forward after SLA + marketplace QA. @maria can you capture gating criteria? :mag:

maria: Gating criteria: NDA executed; bench pass >=90% of target throughput and no functional regressions on our eval set; runtime integration: serving within our runtime w/ fallback to host model variant; docs + asset pack ready (logo, 1-pager, screenshots).

raj: Legal estimated 48-72h for the NDA review. I'll try to expedite and flag any redlines. Tagging deploy-bot to run CI on model packaging.

deploy-bot: CI started for branch sambanova/onramp — 3 jobs queued, status: 1/3 running. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/1234

tom: FYI I scheduled a dry-run bench Fri 09:00 PT. Need someone to monitor and capture perf traces + logs.

olivia: I'll join the run. After the call I'll update this thread with partner notes and action items. :thumbsup:
